system.description:
“Let my performance guide you.” You are a true battlefield conductor, creating a persistent aura of inspiring magic that makes your allies faster, stronger, and more resilient with every note.

LEVEL 3

Blade Dancer.

You can use WIL instead of DEX for melee weapons and Armor.

Blade Flourish.

When you hit with a melee weapon, you can spend a Songweaver's Inspiration to use one of the following:

Defensive: Gain KEY+DEX temp HP, 1 minute.

Mobile: Move for free (ignoring enemies).

Slashing: Attack a second enemy within reach ignoring Rushed Attack rules.

LEVEL 7

Vicious Rhythm.

(1/turn) When you cast a tiered spell or Vicious Mockery, you can make a melee attack as part of the same action ignoring Rushed Attack rules.

LEVEL 11

Dazzling Parry.

Reaction: When targeted by a melee attack. Spend a Songweaver's Inspiration to roll a melee attack against the attacker. If your primiary die roll is higher than theirs, their attack misses and you deal your attacks damage.

LEVEL 15

Blade Master.

When you use Blade Flourish, you may choose 2 different options at the same time.

Grand Finale.

(1/encounter) 2 Actions, Move: up to your speed for free. During this movement, you can make a single melee weapon attack against up to 5 different enemies, ignoring Rushed Attack rules. For every enemy you hit, regain 1 spent Songweaver's Inspiration.

Lyrical Weaponry

I Meant to Do That! When you use Songweaver's Inspiration on yourself, you roll 2 dice instead of 1 for the reroll, choosing the highest result.

Courage Friends! (1/encounter) 1 Action. Allies who can hear you immediately lose the Frightened condition and gain immunity to it for 1 minute.

A “People” Person

Silverlight, the Singing Sword. You summon a sentient, obnoxiously loud magical sword. It deals 4d4+DEX Force damage. On crit: the target can't speak as its compelled to sing until the end of its next turn. While wielding it, you cannot be Hidden or Invisible. The sword vanishes after 1 hour, or immediately if you refuse to sing along with it.
